required_laws: Access geometry is available only in the Street aperture and only from exact-asset semantic receipts.
Shade geometry is available only where an exact scene receipt identifies visible leaf canopy or seasonal open crown.
Water geometry is available only where an exact scene receipt identifies visible roof collection or conveyance features.
Every semantic geometry object is bound to the SHA-256 identity of the exact displayed scene.
Occluded or unverified connections remain absent rather than being completed by interpolation.
Map-only and held states render zero image geometry.
Unsupported instruments and source modes refuse selection.
Care, Heat, Air, Fire, and Assistance do not borrow image geometry.
Export preserves exact asset identity, semantic receipt identity, feature inventory, seat, authority, and public-effect boundary.
